metadata.description: Vadim's 3DLOOK marketing-automation system, packaged as switchable Claude Code plugins: orchestrator + brand/quality control, social, SEO and outbound agent teams. Source of truth is the pristine project under /marketing_vb. Switch into it via profile 'marketing_vb'.

plugins.name: mvb-core
plugins.description: Orchestration core: orchestrator (single entry point), brand-checker, quality-controller, context-pack-builder, agent-improver + all workflow commands (/new-article, /weekly-posts, /outbound, /post-from-article, /qc, /quarterly-review, /improve-agents)

plugins.name: mvb-social
plugins.description: Social team: post-drafter, quarterly-strategist, social-analytics, visual-brief — LinkedIn/organic social from brand assets

plugins.name: mvb-seo
plugins.description: SEO team: seo-planner, seo-writer, seo-editor, seo-publisher — fact-checked long-form articles from approved plans

plugins.name: mvb-outbound
plugins.description: Outbound team: hypothesis-generator, icp-validator, company-researcher, people-extractor, message-sequencer, closelyhq-importer, campaign-analyzer, response-classifier
